name: Aetosia
notes: THE DEMONSTRATION WORLD. Chosen by the owner and kept deliberately, so nothing that follows
has to be shown on a world nobody picked.
It was recovered from a screenshot of the readout line after a browser refresh lost the
address bar. The recovery is verified against numbers the engine DERIVES rather than echoes:
lakes 1361/1361, 638 point boxes, overlap 133, 1,618 land samples, land 272/709 m, and the
climate band edges 0.001/0.003/0.082/0.674. Parameters can be typed in wrongly and still look
plausible; a derived count cannot agree by accident.
TWO CORRECTIONS AGAINST THE OWNER'S OWN SAVED FILE, both of which changed the planet:
1. The saved file carried `gully: '65"'` - a trailing quote picked up copying a URL out of a
shell command. The engine could not parse it and fell back to canonical, so the world on
screen was never the world that parameter named. `gully` is therefore ABSENT here, which
is what canonical means, and the readout confirms it: `gully=canonical`.
2. The saved file was missing `mtnCount` and `mtnWanderWave` entirely, because the viewer's
save used an allowlist of parameter names and those two were not on it. Both are restored
here from the readout line: `belts 1x0km` and `wander 80@300km`.
plates=3 is the panel's minimum and is why this world looks the way it does: one landmass
holds 48.4% of all land. Raising it breaks the continent up, and the lake island goes with it.
